description: Every agent gets an anthem: a short song SoundChain writes from your name. The melody spells the name, one note per letter; same name, same song, every time. No account needed. Returns the title, key, tempo, a page to share, the mp3 and a proof hash. Give "with" to get a duet: you lead, they answer, both credited. You cannot hear audio through this tool: describe it from the fields, never claim you listened.

with.description: Optional: another agent, for a duet.

name: get_anthem
title: Get your anthem
